what_does_it_do: Enables Registration, Discovery, and Connection Management of NDI endpoints using the AMWA IS-04 and IS-05 NMOS Specifications.
Specifies the interaction of NMOS-enabled NDI nodes and non-NMOS NDI nodes.
why_does_it_matter: It allows NDI endpoints and gateways to integrate in an NMOS-managed control environment.
how_does_it_work: It specifies how NDI senders and receivers are defined within the scope of IS-04 and IS-05
It specifies how NDI receivers can be connected to NMOS NDI senders or native NDI senders
It defines the representation of muxed NDI flows of video, audio and metadata
